caption: A subway train roars through a station, and a hanging sign on the platform trembles on its chains.

sa.check: A subway platform with a sign hanging on chains.
A train passes through the station.
The sign trembles on its chains.
The train passes through without stopping.
The sign is not already trembling before the train appears.

pc.expect: The sign hangs still while the platform is quiet and begins to tremble as the train enters.
pc.fail: The sign trembles while the train is not yet in view and the platform is quiet; or the train passes and the sign hangs dead still; or the trembling starts only after the train has fully left.
pc.precondition: The train is in view at some point.

pc.expect: The trembling builds, peaks and dies away in one arc: after its strongest point it only weakens until the sign hangs still.
pc.fail: The trembling weakens and then strengthens again with no train in view; or stops dead in a tilted pose with the chains slack; or the sign is trembling in one frame and hanging still in the next.

pc.expect: The chains stay taut with the sign hanging below its fixing points; the tremble is a small swing about the hanging point.
pc.fail: The chains go slack while the sign stays up; or the sign rises toward the ceiling; or it hangs sideways from a taut chain.

pc.expect: The sign panel is rigid and the chains flex only at their links.
pc.fail: The sign panel bends or ripples; or the chains stretch; or the chains pass through the sign.

pc.expect: One sign on its chains; the train's carriages keep their count; nothing passes through a pillar or the platform.
pc.fail: A second sign appears; or the sign vanishes; or the train passes through a pillar or the platform edge; or carriages appear or vanish mid-train.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sign's lettering, the platform tiles and posters stay the same.
pc.fail: The sign's lettering changes; or the tiles or posters change; or the chains change length.
